digest.component_or_area: local LLM configuration and developer gates
propositions: Local developer gates must be configured to resolve model classes to Bedrock inference profiles and execute end-to-end against real tickets with parseable verdicts and provider provenance tracking.
All LLM calls from local gates must resolve exclusively to Bedrock inference profiles with zero direct-Anthropic calls, verified via REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call tally.
Prompt caching must engage on the Bedrock path, demonstrated by nonzero cache_read_tokens across multiple gate runs rather than write-only results.
Structured output validation must succeed on all three gate types (review-plan, review-code, verify-completion) without INDETERMINATE fallbacks or provider-shaped degradation.
The Bedrock cachePoint TTL behavior must be confirmed and documented; local opt-in and revert to Anthropic must each be executable in a single step.
